title: RFC3339Nano textual order can hide the newest partial runtime observation
impact: The latest partial observation can be ignored, allowing old settled evidence plus a recovered handoff to renew the writer lease; without a recovered handoff, stale-ready evidence can enter transfer.
fix: Determine latest evidence using parsed timestamps, with conservative handling for ties/invalid timestamps, before validating latest settlement. Add a mixed-fractional-precision older-settled/newer-partial regression.
